channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Operation Trashi ends in Kishtwar; JeM commander Saifullah among four terrorists killed
item.description: A 36-day-long anti-terror operation in the higher reaches of Kishtwar district concluded on Sunday with the elimination of three terrorists, taking the total toll to four. Sources said dreaded Jaish-e-Mohammad commander Saifullah, active across the Chenab Valley and accused of masterminding multiple attacks, was among those killed.

item.title: Pawan Kalyan worked up to 18 hours a day for Ustaad Bhagat Singh: Harish Shankar
item.description: Harish Shankar has revealed that power star Pawan Kalyan has worked on this project with complete dedication. He worked up to 18 hours a day for Ustaad Bhagat Singh.

item.title: Trump weighs strike as Iran allies hold back
item.description: While Iran has strengthened ties with China and Russia — including recent naval drills in the Gulf of Oman and planned exercises in the Strait of Hormuz — both nations appear reluctant to provide direct military support in a conflict with the US.

item.title: Army Public School in Delhi's Dhaula Kuan gets bomb threat; probe underway
item.description: Army Public School Dhaula Kuan received a bomb threat via email. Similar threats were recently sent to CRPF Public School Rohini, St. Thomas' School Dwarka and DAV Centenary Public School Paschim Enclave, later declared hoaxes.

item.title: iPhone becomes India's top single export item worth $23 billion last year
item.description: Apple Inc.'s iPhone became India's top single export item in 2025, with shipments worth $23 billion, largely to the US, driven by the government's PLI scheme and supply chain diversification from China. Smartphones emerged as India's leading export category with Apple contributing 76 per cent.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade with strong gains over US tariff developments
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex added 563 points, or 0.68 per cent, to reach 83,375, and Nifty gained 170 points, or 0.67 per cent to settle at 25,741.

item.title: FBI 'dedicating all necessary resources' to probe fatal shooting at Mar-a-Lago
item.description: A 21-year-old North Carolina man was shot dead by US Secret Service agents after breaching the perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, the Florida residence of Donald Trump. He allegedly raised a shotgun when ordered to drop it, prompting officers to open fire.

item.title: 'Entire world wholeheartedly praised India's capabilities': PM Modi on AI Summit
item.description: Narendra Modi said the AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam showcased India's AI capabilities to the world, earning global praise. He highlighted the country's youth-driven innovation ecosystem and stressed research, experimentation, and ethical responsibility in advancing artificial intelligence.

item.title: Adivi Sesh gushes about Mrunal Thakur and Anurag Kashyap's work in Decoit
item.description: Actor Adivi Sesh said that he is a big fan of Mrunal Thakur and Anurag Kashyap. They have important roles in Decoit and they have done wonderful work in the movie.

item.title: Four-day Khelo India Winter Games begin in J&K's Gulmarg today
item.description: The 6th Khelo India Winter Games opened in Gulmarg with 400 athletes from 30 states competing in four snow sports. The event was inaugurated by Lt Governor Manoj Sinha, while Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan is set to attend a convocation at University of Kashmir.
